prompt:
Use case: UI mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app composition, 1536x1024 landscape.

Design an original, shippable first viewport for "MegaBrain Home", a private local-first knowledge graph for expert users who value speed and information density. The product should combine the direct node-map legibility of a technical knowledge graph with the restrained precision, compact density, quiet hierarchy, and receding chrome of a best-in-class modern issue tracker. Do not use either product's logo or copy its branding.

COMPOSITION — GRAPH FIRST:
- 184px dim left rail, 44px top utility bar, large central graph canvas, 304px right evidence inspector, 28px bottom status/legend strip.
- The graph owns roughly 70 percent of the usable viewport and must be visibly interactive, not decorative.
- Left rail text: "Home", "Explore 13", "Timeline 14", "Conflicts 1", "Agents 1", "Imports 0".
- Top bar text: "MegaBrain Home", a compact search field "Search memories…", filter control "All knowledge", and status "Synchronized when generated".
- Central graph: many small circular memory nodes arranged into clear force-directed clusters. Larger topic nodes labeled "Projects", "Design system", "Planning", "Business", "Strategy". The selected "Projects" cluster uses one restrained violet accent. A single conflict node uses muted coral. Show subtle solid directional edges for "Supersedes" and faint dotted edges for "Shared tag". The graph has enough density to feel real but labels never become a cloud.
- Right inspector: "Projects", "6 memories", a compact section "Current evidence" with rows "Launch state", "Roadmap", "Design review"; selected row shows "Confirmed", "Updated Aug 24", "History 2", and a quiet action "Open Markdown".
- Bottom strip legend: "Current", "Historical", "Supersedes", "Shared tag", "Conflict"; also show "13 memories · 5 topics · 1 conflict".

VISUAL SYSTEM:
- Near-black warm graphite background #0B0C0E; panels #111317 and #17191D; primary text #F3F4F6; muted text #8B9099; hairlines #25282E; selected accent #7C6EF6; conflict #F06A6A.
- Compact neutral sans-serif UI, 12–13px operational text, 15px section titles, exact spacing rhythm, reduced icon sizes, flat surfaces, 1px soft separators.
- Navigation recedes; graph and selected evidence command attention.
- Structure should be felt through alignment and tone, not boxed into cards.
- Practical product screenshot with correct information hierarchy, crisp vector-like graph geometry, no presentation theater.

Hard exclusions: no hero headline, no marketing copy, no large stat cards, no bento grid, no glassmorphism, no gradients, no glow, no neon, no shadows, no rounded pill overload, no illustration, no botanical imagery, no celestial imagery, no paper texture, no physical metaphor, no anatomical brain, no AI neural-network cliché, no people, no browser or device frame, no logo, no watermark.
